slots.name: season rebounds
slots.sentence: Reese also set a single-season franchise record for total rebounds (446) for the Sky and became the fastest WNBA player to reach 20 double-doubles in a season in her first year in the league.

slots.name: draft pick
slots.sentence: Reese has been a double-double machine since being selected out of LSU with the No. 7 overall pick in the 2024 draft by the Chicago Sky.

slots.name: consecutive double-doubles
slots.sentence: In her rookie season, Reese recorded 15 consecutive double-doubles to set a record for the longest streak since Candace Parker had 12 in a row between the 2009 and 2010 seasons.
